input.question: For my monthly recap I need the fastest pit stop made during any F1 race held in September 2016. Please tell me the driver's full name, the pit stop time, the name of the race where it happened, the circuit name, and the circuit location. If two or more pit stops share the fastest time, list each of them with its own driver, race, circuit name and circuit location.
input.evidence: By pit stop time I mean the elapsed time of a pit stop, from the car arriving at its pit to rejoining the race.

            MIN(p.milliseconds) OVER () AS fastest_ms

 SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,

arguments.sql:
SELECT r.date, COUNT(*) AS stops, COUNT(d.driverId) AS matched_drivers,
       COUNT(c.circuitId) AS matched_circuits, COUNT(p.milliseconds) AS timed_stops,
       MIN(p.milliseconds) AS minimum_ms
FROM races AS r
JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
LEFT JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01' AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.date

arguments.sql:
WITH september_stops AS (
    SELECT p.driverId, p.milliseconds, r.name AS race_name, r.circuitId,
           MIN(p.milliseconds) OVER () AS fastest_ms
    FROM pitStops AS p
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
    WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01' AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       s.milliseconds / 1000.0 AS pit_stop_seconds,
       s.race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM september_stops AS s
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = s.circuitId
WHERE s.milliseconds = s.fastest_ms
LIMIT -1
